items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: And Ziggy Elman got up at bat and he had this big cigar in the way, it discombobulated the pitcher.

ctx.x: Well I wasn’t there, it was before I came into Bob’s life, but my favorite thing was he said Lester Young was the pitcher. I thought this vague guy being a pitcher, that must have been some game. When Shorty, my first husband, was with Tommy Dorsey they had baseball games. And Harry James was this corny guy that took everything so seriously, and they came to play the Dorsey band in Bernardsville at Tommy Dorsey’s palatial estate. And they were kind of kidding around, the Dorsey band. But Harry James’ band were…
Was there a strong sense of competition between the big bands at that time?
